posts.title: Where did my creativity go?
posts.description: Rediscovering a handful of old drawings led me to ask a question I hadn't considered in years: when did creating stop being fun and start feeling like something I had to be good at?

posts.title: Goodbye, Destiny 2
posts.description: A reflection on a decade spent with Destiny 2, exploring how the game became a shared space for friendship, connection, and memory through different stages of my life.

posts.title: On Starting a Blog
posts.description: A reflection on my first attempt at blogging, what caused it to fail, and why I'm giving writing another chance six years later.
